items.title: The derived pullback along a morphism of ringed topoi sends quasi-coherent objects to quasi-coherent objects

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the derived pullback Lg^* maps the quasi-coherent objects of D(O) into those of D(O') (statement lines 11500-11505). The proof (proof lines 11507-11550) is an explicit computation over a single object U' of C': the commutative diagram of ringed topoi built from U' and its image U gives R Gamma(U', Lg^*K) = R Gamma(U, K) tensor^L_{O(U)} O'(U') by composition of derived pullbacks, and the cartesianity identity for a morphism U' -> V' then follows by associativity of the derived tensor product together with the quasi-coherence of K. H2: one diagram computation followed by an associativity chain, all written out.
